transcript: Speaker A (AI): Hello, what is your name? Speaker B (Raj): My name is Raj. on_screen_text: Dialogue subtitles in Hindi and English. End card: SpeakEasy AI. Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy. Install Now.
summary: An AI avatar corrects a user's English grammar errors in a video call setup, pitching the SpeakEasy app as a convenient, affordable solution for daily practice. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
